authorCanonical.name: Bella
authorCanonical.bio: Bella is the founder of QFCNCMachine and has over 15 years of hands-on experience in CNC machining, precision tooling, and manufacturing process optimisation. Based in Daling Mountain Town, Dongguan, Guangdong — the heart of China’s precision manufacturing belt — she works directly with aerospace, automotive, and medical clients across Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia. QFCNCMachine has served 750+ customers worldwide since its establishment in 2010, delivering precision machining centers backed by a 2-year warranty and full after-sales support.
